declaration.parameters: finite V; graph G; k,a,b natural; chi(G)=k; CliqueFree k; a,b>=2; a+b=k+1

github.spurious_numeric_hit: PR #628 is Erdős Problem 355, not this target

local_coverage.prior_classification: excluded: graph decomposition universal needing unbounded auxiliary search

details: if claw-free and contains K_s: t<=4s-3

exact_reasoning.chi_lower: Across the near-join, a color can occur in both factors only on the unique nonadjacent pair (x,u), so at least 2+5-1=6 colors are required.
exact_reasoning.chi_upper: Color H5-u with four colors, give u and x one shared color, and give y a sixth color.
exact_reasoning.clique_free: H5 is triangle-free; every clique uses at most two H5 vertices and at most x,y, hence omega<=4<6.
exact_reasoning.threshold_split: the induced K2 factor has chromatic number 2 and the induced H5 factor has chromatic number 5

graph.construction: Let H3=C5 and H_(r+1)=Mycielski(H_r). Let H5=M(M(C5)), with distinguished latest apex u. Add adjacent vertices x,y, make each complete to H5 except omit xu.

open_domain_checks.witnesses: H5 has the latest-apex induced claw, an induced C4 from a length-two base path and two shadows, and alpha>=3

first_stop_gate: Recompute exact chromatic number after the sole deletion. Stop immediately unless chi=6 and CliqueFree 6; do not search partitions on a failed premise.
graph_encoding: recursive canonical Mycielski labels: originals first, then shadows in matching order, then apex; K2 vertices follow H5

operation.delete: the embedded original-C5 edge {1,2} inside H5

prediction.premise_risk: the full graph may fall from chi 6 to chi 5; this is deliberately unresolved until Phase 1
prediction.if_premise_survives: exactly decide whether any vertex subset gives induced chromatic thresholds 2 and 5; stop at first certified absence or complete hold

selection_reason: Deleting an internal edge of the 5-critical factor attacks the displayed tight 5-chromatic block. Restoring xu raises chi to 7; deleting a cross edge preserves the displayed factor split; deleting xy admits an immediate replacement split {y,u} versus x join (H5-u).

next_action: Phase 1 may evaluate only the one frozen internal-edge deletion, beginning with the exact premise gate.
